definitions.first_pass: no overshoot / re-approach in the episode
definitions.heading error: angle between the executed direction and the line of sight to the asset's CURRENT position at the decision (vs to the asset's INITIAL position = an obsolete location)
definitions.tracks_current_asset: over the last 3 decisions the mean heading error to the current asset is smaller than to the initial asset location
